name: microbe XR
summary: Microbe XR is a science discovery game where you discover the amazing world of microbes from the carbon atom to the red blood cell. with an intuitive UI and multiple scenes of game play, users can diagnose patients' symptoms and battle bacteria in this fun, unique learning play environment. Developed by MedMicroMaps Inc. microbe XR is a completely novel new learning system with accurate 3d models and colors and not AI generated.
